author: johaaaxd
quote: 13 years of waiting just to release a game full of bugs is simply unacceptable. We’re talking about GTA VI, one of the most anticipated video games in history, developed by a multibillion-dollar company with virtually unlimited resources. After all this time, the bare minimum players should expect is a polished, stable game that lives up to the hype. Ambitious graphics and a massive open world shouldn’t be used as excuses for technical issues. If a company takes over a decade to release a video game, it should also be prepared to face criticism when the final product fails to reflect that enormous investment of time and money. A long wait builds expectations, but it doesn’t guarantee quality.
